name: Minimal-Pattern Coefficient Bound
statement: In a separation-margin $t$-certificate, if $p$ is a minimal missing pattern with support $P$, then every normalized row coefficient satisfies $a_{p,i}\ge2t/(1+t)$ and $t\le1/(2|P|-1)$. Hence every row coefficient is strictly positive whenever $t>0$.
proof: Minimality supplies a concept agreeing with $p$ outside each chosen coordinate $i$ and having the opposite sign at $i$. Evaluating the row at that witness gives $t(1-a_{p,i})-a_{p,i}\le-t$, which yields the coefficient bound. Summing it over the normalized row yields the margin bound.
